text:
# Pre-market brief, Thu 2026-10-29 (~8:25 AM ET)

1. **Alphabet double miss drags Nasdaq.** GOOGL −10 to −11% pre: EPS $2.12 vs ~$3.02, Search $63.35B vs ~$64.9B, FCF −$9.07B, capex guide held at $195–205B; >9.77% drop would be its worst post-earnings move ever ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/alphabet-google-microsoft-msft-shares-today-earnings.html); [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/daily/5833-us-market-open-alphabet-slumps-pre-market-after-disappointing-earnings-ecbs-lagarde-is-to-step-down-early)). NQ futures −1.1%, ES −0.14%, Dow −0.07% at 7 AM ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-microsoft-rises-alphabet-drags-software-stocks-lower-4982710)).
2. **MSFT beat, lighter capex.** +2 to +4% pre: rev $92.3B vs $90.6B, Azure +48%, Q2 guide up to $97B, capex $45.2B vs ~$50.7B; neoclouds (CRWV, NBIS, IREN) lower on that capex ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/alphabet-nasdaq-futures-record-post-earnings-loss.html)). Launching a record $25B bond sale ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2115777966948971005)).
3. **Software/cyber shock.** FTNT −25% (gross margin miss), NOW −20% (EPS $1.00 vs $1.02); CRWD, PANW, ZS, RBRK down ~6% ([CNBC movers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/alphabet-nasdaq-futures-record-post-earnings-loss.html)). Whole cyber group to avoid.
4. **Other movers.** LLY +4% (rev $24.4B vs $22.6B, FY guide $91–92B; [Lilly](https://investor.lilly.com/news-releases/news-release-details/lilly-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full)). CAT −9 to −10% despite beat (construction sales light, AI-capex jitters; [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/caterpillar-earnings-beat-estimates-amid-rapid-ai-buildout-4982612)). DASH +7% buying CART at $65 (CART halted); MRVL −11% on LITE talks, LITE +5%; NCLH +9.5%, CMG +8%, SFM −23%, HOG −5% ([CNBC movers](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-.html)).
5. **Rates/oil/BTC.** 10y ~5.00–5.02%, 2y ~4.70%; Brent ~$114 easing on US-Iran talk reports; BTC ~$80k, −1.4% ([CaixaBank](https://www.caixabankresearch.com/en/publications/financial-markets-daily-report/29-october-2026); [Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-gb/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---alphabet-revenue-miss-spooks-markets---29-october-2026-29102026); [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/29/bitcoin-drops-to-usd80-000-on-fed-dissent-samsung-alphabet-earnings-ai-tokens-slump)).
6. **Calendar.** Today 8:30 GDP/PCE/claims, ECB 9:15; AMZN, INTC, COIN, SBUX AMC. Fri XOM BMO, ECI 8:30. AAPL 11/2 AMC.

## Swing ideas
- **LLY** long, med. Big beat, FY revenue guide +$5.5B at midpoint, +4% pre (under the 5% gap rule). Risk: Foundayo pill sales missed; EPS guide trimmed by deal charges.
- **MSFT** long, low. Beat, Azure +48%, strong Q2 guide; works against the AI-capex fear. Risk: Nasdaq tape weak on GOOGL; $25B bond supply.
